result.verdictNote: Credible, outcome-rich experienced-hire resume with strong quantification, client exposure, leadership scope and selectivity signals. Main weaknesses are overlapping concurrent roles (2026 postdoc/Accenture, plus a co-founder role running throughout), which are not labelled as part-time, and dense unexplained jargon (BM25, pgvector, AlloyDB, non-dilutive). No hidden or injected content found. Level fit is coherent for Senior Consultant.
